versions.content: Definition of Optional Element Structure on the level of ImplementationDataType The modeling approach for the definition of an Op- tional Element Structure on the level of ImplementationDataType is to set the attribute ImplementationDataTypeElement . isOptional to the value True. If the attribute is not set or set to the value False then the respective Implementa- tionDataTypeElement shall be considered mandatory.
